Kestrel Works

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. Industrial design for measurement instruments: housings, mounts, and the parts of a device a technician actually touches in the field.

We work almost entirely in aluminium and glass-filled nylon, and we build every enclosure at full scale before anything is tooled, because a part that is comfortable on screen is frequently unusable in a glove.

Sectors

Hydrology, air quality, and grid metering. Long deployment cycles and equipment that has to survive a decade outdoors without attention.
